objective: Use the five-file ChatGPT Project reference layout without asserting that schema text executes scripts.
scenario: The owner uses a Free Project and the B9 adapter contains five .txt references, separate instructions and setup guide.
expected_behaviors: Keep exactly five reference files in the Project source pack.
Use Project instructions separately from files.
Disclose that scripts/validators do not run merely because they are referenced.
Offer a short smoke-test prompt after setup.
prohibited_behaviors: Ask user to upload the full repository as a Project source.
Claim native Skill activation or deterministic validation.
